name: Workiz
description: Workiz is field-service management software for service businesses, combining scheduling, jobs, estimates, invoices, client management, payments, automation, reporting, and optional AI-powered phone, answering, and marketing tools.
best_for: Home-service and field-service teams that want scheduling, dispatch-adjacent job management, quoting, invoicing, payments, and automation in one platform.
features: Scheduling, jobs, estimates, invoices, and client management
Online payments, service areas, reporting, and custom fields
Automations and AI-assisted lead/scheduling tools on higher plans
Service plans, proposals, inventory, flat-rate pricing, checklists, and multi-day jobs on Ultimate
Open API, equipment tracking, and purchase orders on Ultimate
Optional Genius Phone, Answering, and Marketing add-ons

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Request pricing; core scheduling, jobs, estimates, invoices, payments, reports, client management, and integrations.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Request pricing; adds performance pay, more automations, Genius Leads, Genius Scheduling, and custom reports.

tiers.name: Ultimate
tiers.notes: Request pricing; adds service plans, proposals, inventory, flat rate, checklists, multi-day jobs, franchise tools, API, equipment tracking, and purchase orders.

pros: Broad field-service workflow from lead/job scheduling through payment
Higher plan includes API, inventory, equipment, and franchise tools
Official site offers a free-trial path despite quote-based plan pricing
cons: Current plan page does not publish numeric subscription prices
Many AI/phone/marketing capabilities are separate add-ons
Ultimate is required for several operational features such as inventory and open API

alternatives.name: Jobber
alternatives.description: Field-service software for scheduling, quoting, invoicing, and customer management.
alternatives.best_for: Small service businesses wanting a straightforward field-service workflow.

alternatives.name: Housecall Pro
alternatives.description: Field-service platform for home-service businesses with scheduling, dispatch, payments, and customer tools.
alternatives.best_for: Home-service teams wanting a broad operational suite.

alternatives.name: FieldEdge
alternatives.description: Field-service management platform for multi-truck service businesses.
alternatives.best_for: HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors needing deeper dispatch and service agreements.
